## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. SPY in RECOVERY (1W: +4.31% | 1M: -1.69%) and QQQ in RECOVERY (1W: +5.43% | 1M: -1.74%) show a short-term bounce while risk ratios read flat, providing two independent confirmations for a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress EASING: HYG (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +0.52%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD ↑. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -10.57% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND — VXX ↓. Commodity impulse from oil/energy: USO (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) ABOVE TREND supporting cyclicals despite XLE softness.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -1.67%) RECOVERY and UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +1.02%) — yields and dollar showing mild bifurcation, overall conditions neither easing nor tightening materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) with Industrials/XBI strength: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.48% | 1M: +3.91%); Energy lagging: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%). Style: Growth/Momentum leading, confirmed by sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US shows relative strength: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +0.98%) and SPY RECOVERY (1W: +4.31% | 1M: -1.69%); EM/China recovering: EEM RECOVERY (1W: +4.68% | 1M: -0.02%) and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -0.95%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation healthy: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +8.25% | 1M: -5.03%), IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +1.30%), and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) — flows favor higher-beta/tech segments.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Broad commodity bid led by oil: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) and strong 1M moves in energy/commodities, while metals show short-term recovery: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +4.16% | 1M: -8.81%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -13.17%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) vs XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +21.77%); natural gas weakening: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +0.98%). DIVERGENCE: SPY/QQQ RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) and XLE CORRECTION (1M up, 1W down) — a MAJOR divergence across equities vs energy that calls for selectivity.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor selective growth exposure: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.48% | 1M: +3.91%); reduce exposure to energy beta and gas: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%), while monitoring VXX (1W: -10.57% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND for volatility regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +12.26% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +8.48% | 1M: +3.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.91% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: USO (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +26.95%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.46% | 1M: -4.35%) RECOVERY for cyclical demand signals.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -9.41%) BELOW TREND and select metals SLV (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -13.17%) RECOVERY — watch for profit-taking.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (complacency watch), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth healthy at 8/11 sectors positive, but risk ratios and cycle signals are flat. XLK, SOXX and XBI showing relative strength while XLE and UNG exhibit notable divergence to monitor.
